pages.text: $(bold)Mars — The Red Planet$()$(br)Mobs: $(bold){{dim ad_astra:mars difficulty}}$() the vanilla strength, like every Tier 4 world$(br)Death penalty: $(bold){{dim ad_astra:mars death}}$()$(br2)Cold, hostile, and unforgiving. Mars demands preparation beyond the Moon. The thin atmosphere provides no protection from the extreme cold.

$(bold)Environmental Hazards$()$(br)• $(bold)Cold damage$() ticks constantly without Frostward or cold protection$(br)• $(bold)Faster hunger drain$() — bring extra food or Golden Apples$(br)• Cold-themed mobs are adapted to the environment$(br2)The Frostward enchantment is highly valuable here. Without it, you will take continuous cold damage that adds up quickly.

$(bold)Purpose$()$(br)Mars contains ores and materials required for the $(bold)Tier 3 Rocket$() to reach Venus and Mercury. Explore the Martian ruins and underground facilities for rare loot.$(br2)$(bold)Recommended Gear$()$(br)• Netherite Space Suit or MekaSuit$(br)• Frostward-enchanted armor$(br)• High-saturation food supply$(br)• Established RF power for oxygen production

$(bold)Planetary Rock Extraction$()$(br)Crush $(bold)Mars Stone$() in Create Crushing Wheels or a Thermal Pulverizer to extract:$(br)• $(bold)Ferric Oxide$() (30%) — heat-resistant compound$(br)• $(bold)Cryogenic Crystal$() (15%) — cold-resistant tech$(br)• Redstone (40%)$(br2)The Thermal Pulverizer gives slightly better odds.

$(bold)Thermal Regulation Enchantment$()$(br)Mars mobs have a $(bold)12% chance$() to drop an enchanted book of $(bold)Thermal Regulation$() (max level 3). This armor enchantment:$(br)• Negates cold and heat environmental damage$(br)• Each level reduces temperature damage by 33%$(br)• At level 3, fully negates Mars cold and Mercury cold$(br2)Also effective on Glacio's extreme cold.$(br2)$(bold)Next: crush Mars Stone until you hold the Cryogenic Crystals the Tier 3 Rocket needs.$()
